purpose: Planning and evidence template, not a tool payload or completed production record

recordingGuidance.references: Record path, source, rights, consent when relevant, intended role, observed project name/identity, and approval.
recordingGuidance.shots: Record shot ID, requested/observed settings, exact reference set/roles, preparation job, authorization, quote, submission outcome, remote completion evidence, selected asset identity, verified original download path, working-copy path, and visual/audio review.
recordingGuidance.unknown: Keep missing observations null; never manufacture IDs, success, zero spend, audio, or readiness.
